violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CDI: CFM showed up at the end of inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored above diced tomatoes and cucumber salad and yogurt-based sauce inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: raw shelled eggs relocate to the bottom shelf inside the walk-in refrigerator.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: yogurt-based sauce (48F) in container above soda dispenser in the expo/ server area and metal container of caramelized onion (53F) stored on prep counter in the prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM placed container of yogurt-based sauce in ice bath to cool back to 41F and cold hold. CFM agreed to monitor and change out ice when needed. CFM relocated metal container of caramelized onions to the walk in refrigerator to cool to 41F and will cold hold in Turbo Air 2 Dr stacked refrigerator on prep area.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: recently prepared diced tomatoes and cucumber salad (67F) cooling inside top part of the Hoshizaki 2 Dr preptop refrigerator (front prep area).
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI: CFM relocated diced tomatoes and cucumber salad to walk in refrigerator to cool to 41F.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Food employee observed wearing jewelry (silver bracelet) on their arms/wrists/ hands while preparing food in prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CDI: CFM instructed food employee to remove silver bracelet from wrist and washed hands before returning to preparing food.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: heavily scorn red cutting board stored on shelf in front prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. CDI: CFM agreed to discontinue using the cutting board.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): observed two milk crates throughout the main kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. CDI: CFM removed the milk crateds from the kitchen.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Beverage Air 2 Dr UR ambient temperature of 45F on cookline. EHS observed refrigerator unit overfilled with jugs of whole white milk and torn door gasket.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: CFM relocated multiple jugs of milk to the walk in refrigerator to allow for better air flow throughout unit. EHS instructed CFM to schedule repair of torn door gasket.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The floor basin under the 3 compartment sink in the main kitchen is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CDI: CFM instructed employees to clean floor basin/ remove debris to allow for easier flow for drainage.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: uncooked chicken parts stored directly over green tandoori sauce inside walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated uncooked chicken parts to bottom shelf of walk in refrigerator.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: housemade beef stew inside Hoshizaki 2 Dr stacked refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM labeled housemade beef stew with 5 day expiration date.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: chelo kabob offering raw egg as topping.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. EHS scheduled follow up for CFM to add reminder (asterisk) to menu item

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: incorrect disclosure statement verbiage for consuming undercooked/ raw food items health risks.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. CDI: EHS emailed CFM correct disclosure statement verbiage for consuming undercooked/ raw food items health risks.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: Observed the certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EHS scheduled follow up for CFM to provide probe food thermometer. SHAMSHIRY CHOLO KABOB (Inspection Date: 12/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing sign that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided at the front handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. CDI: CFM placed hand washing sign at front hand sink.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed 2 working chemical spray bottles are not properly labeled with a common name in kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CFM labeled the 2 working chemical spray bottle.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: box of frozen Cornish hens improperly thawing on floor in kitchen prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: CFM place frozen Cornish hens in prep sink over cool running water.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location in Holding Units
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device in the following mechanically refrigerated unit was not properly located in the warmest part of the unit: Observed no or broken ambient thermometer in all cold hold units in the main kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanically refrigerated unit the sensor of a temperature measuring device shall be located to measure the air temperature of a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of the refrigerator. Store the thermometer near the door of the unit. CFM will order ambient thermometer for cold hold units holding TCS food items SHAMSHIRY CHOLO KABOB (Inspection Date: 07/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed box of Cornish hens placed directly on the floor in the kitchen food prep area. Observed bucket of food stored directly on the floor inside of the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM placed frozen cornish hens in kitchen prep sink for proper thawing. CFM relocated bucket of food to shelf inside of walk in cooler.
